note: Column 1 of the Blanket Builder. Every field below is QUOTED OR DIRECTLY TRANSCRIBED from hierarchical-aif/docs/MOTOR-STACK-MARKOV-BLANKET-JUSTIFICATION.md. Nothing here is authored by an agent; where wording is the document's, it is marked verbatim. This is what the code ACTUALLY instantiates today.
formalPartition: external psi, sensory s, active a, internal mu, with blanket b = s union a, and the substantive requirement mu independent of psi given b.

blankets.name: Blanket A - the ANALYST's

internal.text: mu, tau, and the per-motor belief q(eta_m) from hierarchy.posterior_motor_shape

active.text: choice of next experiment - exercised at ORCHESTRATE level, OUTSIDE the dataset

external.text: the physical motor, the cell, and the apparatus

blankets.defect: a = EMPTY SET within the dataset. The document's own ruling R1: "A partition without active states is not a full Markov blanket." What is instantiated is a sensory-only boundary - a conditional-independence screen over a passively observed system.
blankets.defectVerbatim: There is no action field in the event record and no action field in the motor record. The set is empty, not small.
blankets.structural: no additional quantity of Wadhwa-2022 passive recording would create the channel

blankets.name: Blanket B - the MOTOR's

sensory.text: ligand binding, PMF sensing, torque load sensing

blankets.defect: DESIGN_ONLY. This is the blanket that would carry any claim that the organism performs inference, and it is the one we do not have.
blankets.opportunity: Column 2 and column 3 exist to build THIS blanket from cited signals - each slot filled with a signal that a real source documents as crossing, opening, or closing the boundary.

requiredProperties.property: mu independent of psi given b (internal independent of external given the blanket)
requiredProperties.why: psi - load, PMF, stator number, temperature, viscosity, CheY-P - is unobserved. An independence claim cannot be tested against a variable that was never recorded.

requiredProperties.property: Events exchangeable within a motor given eta_m
requiredProperties.why: Requires a within-recording condition timeseries; none exists.
population_log_likelihood assumes it. nominalElectrorotationSpeed varies between motors at 7 levels, which is a known between-motor inhomogeneity the model does not condition on.

requiredProperties.property: Sensory channel free of instrument variation
requiredProperties.why: sampleIntervalS constant at 0.02 s on train motors; runCount 3-83 remains an open route.

operatorFrame.definition: A Markov blanket in biology is a boundary where something CROSSES - ions, force, a phosphoryl group, a ligand - and it is identified by the SIGNALS THAT GATE the crossing: what opens it, what stops it. Nested layers are found by following the gating signals inward.
operatorFrame.exemplars: osmosis (when does a cell open to receive) and gland secretion (what signal triggers release, what signal stops it)
operatorFrame.prediction: On the flagellum the blankets will be FEW AND SIMPLE, consistent with the biology literature.
operatorFrame.predictionStatus: OPERATOR PREDICTION - recorded before the inventory was built, to be checked against it, not assumed by it.
